newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to chug higher, eye 1993's 115-24.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to chug higher, eye 1993's 115-24.

text.p: June gilts, having set new contract highs on Friday, have to look to continuation chart levels back to 1993-94 for their next resistance levels, analysts said.
They said the market has been tracing out an ascending wedge since the middle of 1994 which came in exactly near the current high on Friday, at 114-15.

"If we break out from the upper boundary of this ascending wedge it looks like the market will possibly move on towards 115-24 which was a peak from back in 1993," said Steve Hutt, technical analyst at NatWest Financial Futures in London.
June gilts at 0731 GMT were at 114-09, up 13/32 on the day.
On continuation charts, gilt futures set a temporary peak at 114-24 in October 1993 before roaring up to a 121-06 major high.
"All in all I think it's looking positive but as is always the case with these things, we'll probably see some consolidation," said Hutt.

Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a technical research note that if an aggressive move through 115-26 came about there would be little to stop gilts from going to 121-06, although such a big break was not favoured at the moment.
Hutt added that trading the gilt/Bund spread for convergence was a good way to play the market.
